title: SOVOS · Uncertainty Pixel Shader · Post-Sigma
description: The uncertainty pixel shader. Renders calibrated uncertainty (sigma) as a GPU WebGL effect. Honest visualisation: only runs on CALIBRATED data (ECE ≤ 0.05), enforced by the sigma calibration gate.
text: SOVOS · Uncertainty Pixel Shader · Post-Sigma ⟁ SOVOS · Uncertainty Shader ⚠ SIGMA GATE LOCKED ECE ≤ 0.05 required σ Uncertainty Field Gate status LOCKED Temperature (T) 1.00 Sigma (σ) 1.00 Field density 4.0 Pulse speed 1.0 ⚗ Simulate Calibration → UNLOCK The shader is gated: it will NOT render the calibrated uncertainty field until the sigma-calibration gate verifies ECE ≤ 0.05 (≥100 samples). This makes the visualisation honest — uncalibrated "90% confidence" is never painted. Click "Simulate Calibration" to run the gate (see the Python package sovos-sigma-calibration for the real engine).
